comparison.objective: Align and press two boards together over three dowels, versus adjust and lock a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-2003 requires bimanual multi-axis insertion and even pressing across three pins; the candidate requires rotational tool seating and countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: PR-2003 scores insertion depth, seam gaps, flush edges, flatness, release, and stillness; the candidate scores retained angular calibration and cycles.
comparison.reason: Multi-dowel alignment and insertion are unrelated to adjustable-stop locking.
